settings.editor: A closer look at a few recent jobs: what the home needed, how we approached it, and what the owners thought.

The owners bought their log home knowing it would need refinishing. We media blasted the old finish, applied a few colors to the logs so they could choose, and finished inside the schedule their home-based business needed. The interior was protected throughout.

“We never imagined our home could look as beautiful and transformed as it does today.”

Lee F.

icon_list.text: Photo: deck restoration and rot repair

settings.editor: An old deck with rot in the structure. We replaced the damaged wood, treated what remained and restored the finish. The project came in under the original estimate.

“They took an old, rotting deck and restored it so beautifully that we will be able to enjoy it for decades to come.”

Hervey L., architect
A whole-home interior repaint, run to a budget and finished on schedule by a tidy, efficient crew.
